summary_en: ALSOK will cancel 20,824,210 treasury shares on November 30, 2026, reducing outstanding shares to 489,376,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 10, 2026, ALSOK's board of directors resolved to cancel 20,824,210 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to be effective on November 30, 2026. After this cancellation, the outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) will total 489,376,000, representing a reduction of approximately 4.1% from the pre-cancellation base.
